Title: New Azure Mobile Engagement SDKs for Xamarin, Unity, and web (preview) available

Body.Content:
You can now integrate Azure Mobile Engagement in your apps if you are developing for Xamarin.iOS or Xamarin.Android by using our Xamarin SDK.

You can also integrate Azure Mobile Engagement if you are writing a gaming app by using our Unity SDK. Documentation is available for iOS and Android.

And finally, we have released a preview of the Web SDK. You can use this SDK to collect analytics in a way that's similar to what Azure Mobile Engagement does. There is no support for sending push notifications at the moment with the Web SDK.
